summary: Wrote the homily 'My Words Shall Not Pass' (about 1,435 spoken words, an estimated 11.0-12.0 minutes at 120-130 wpm) for an adult parish assembly, following the third interpretation with the literal sense of the flight from the second: the disciples' 'when?', the fulfilled flight (Chrysostom, Bede on Pella), the lightning against date-setters, Chrysostom on 'this generation', Gregory on the word that does not pass, Augustine on the Gradual's past tense, Chrysostom on the Epistle's thanks, Jerome on the Introit's call to prayer, and the Communion with Mk 11:25 and Bede's condition. It gives one response (forgive before Communion) and closes on the Secret and Gregory's gladness at the world's end. Added the terminal note and References, the [document.homily] table, a contribution line and the production-review entry; the refresh wrote homily.tex. All homily content checks, preflight and a 4-page author proof pass.
